regions.purpose: The left half of the skinny peek — the Location's display name and coordinates. Identifies the Location the pin sits at.

The right half of the skinny peek — a vertically scrolling list of every Collection Entry that references this Location, one per Collection. Each row shows the owning Collection's name and appearance color and the Entry's reviewed/unreviewed state.

affordances.label: Add another Entry at this Location

shows: the Entry's reviewed or unreviewed state

lists.emptyState: A Location with no Entries cannot be reached from MapOverview — pins exist only where there is at least one Entry. A one-Entry list renders as a single row above the add-entry affordance.
